name: research
description: Design, synchronize, launch, track, and visualize reproducible research experiments across GPU rigs.

interface.shortDescription: Reproducible experiment operations across GPU rigs
interface.longDescription: Structure and synchronize research projects, design experiments, dispatch GPU sweeps, reconcile run state, maintain a research journal, and create result visualizations.
defaultPrompt: Design a reproducible experiment and agree on its run identity.
Synchronize project source and artifacts across configured GPU rigs.
Plan and dispatch an approved sweep across available GPU rigs.
Reconcile experiment status from artifacts, status files, and logs.
